description: This PHP class, HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_StrictBlockquote, defines behavior for handling 'blockquote' child elements in strict mode within the HTMLPurifier library. It manages allowed elements, validates children nodes, and wraps content appropriately.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_StrictBlockquote
classes.description: Defines handling of 'blockquote' elements in strict mode, including allowed child elements and validation logic.

methods.name: getAllowedElements
methods.description: Returns the list of fake elements allowed within the blockquote.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Validates and potentially wraps child nodes of the blockquote based on strict rules.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the element definitions, preparing real and fake element sets.
